# GOM Haddock Numbers at age


**Description**: 

Historical numbers at age (mean) of Gulf of Maine haddock.  Depending on 
the timing of the most recent stock assessment, these contain a mix of 
assessment estimates and a "bridge" to current regulatory year. The bridging is
performed in a manner consistent with the stock projections, but may be updated with
realized commercial and recreational removals. 

Simulated future numbers at age for Gulf of Maine Haddock

GOM Haddock Cod has 9 age classes (Age 1 to Age 8 and Age 9+).

**Years available**: 

Mean historical numbers at age are provided for the most recent 3 years.  

Projected numbers at age are provided for the upcoming management year.


## Methods

### Data sources

All are derived from the most recent stock assessment ([2026 Management Track](https://apps-nefsc.fisheries.noaa.gov/saw/sasi_files.php?year=2026&species_id=5&stock_id=2&review_type_id=6&info_type_id=-1&map_type_id=&filename=Gulf_of_Maine_Haddock_SAR_2026.pdf))
that was used for providing specifications advice to fishery managers

### Data extraction 

Inputs need for stock assessment were obtained from stock assessment scientists. 
This includes the "WHAM" model file weight-at-age excel file.

### Data analysis/Processing

[Data processing code](https://github.com/kimberly-bastille/groundfishRDM/blob/main/Code/pre_sim/process_haddock_assessment_data.R) can be seen in the groundfishRDM repository. In brief, for 2027 fishery management, we

1.  Use the stock assessment projections as they are provided to fishery managers.  
2.  We extract mean NAA through 2026.
3.  We simulate 500 draws of the Numbers-at-Age for each age class for 2027 based on 
the mean and standard deviations from WHAM.
